one_liner: One end-to-end composition flow: read live state, act on that data, then verify through fresh chain queries — all from a single request.
what_it_does: This lamp shows the full loop: read live data from the chain, run a skill action on what it found, then verify the result with new chain queries. Each stage's output feeds the next — nothing is hard-coded. Proven by 2 real transactions on the Atlantic testnet, all linked below.
